transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in today?

I came in because I just can’t keep my mind on one thing lately. I’ll be working on something, like fixing a rendering bug, and then a Slack notification goes off, or I notice some color pattern on the screen, or hear a siren outside, and suddenly I’m off thinking about something completely different before I even finish the line of code. It’s been making it really hard to get anything done.
Do you often feel restless, as if you need to be moving or doing something constantly, even when you're trying to relax or focus?

Yeah, pretty often. It feels like there’s this constant current running through me. I wake up already thinking about features, layouts, press angles, code changes—just a whole list of things I need to do. And when I sit still, even if I’m supposed to be relaxing, it feels like I’m wasting time or missing the moment.
Have you ever had sudden episodes where you felt intense fear, a racing heart, or a sense that something bad was going to happen out of the blue?

I don’t think so, not really. I mean, I get worked up or keyed up sometimes, but I haven’t noticed sudden episodes where I’m terrified out of nowhere or feel like something terrible is about to happen.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt down, depressed, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

I’m not really sure. I wouldn’t say I’ve felt depressed exactly, and I haven’t noticed losing interest in things. It’s more that my attention has been all over the place, but not like I’m sad all the time.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually energetic, needed less sleep, or were more talkative or confident than usual?

Yeah, I have periods like that. Lately it’s like I’m running on this constant current. I wake up already planning things—features, layouts, press angles, code changes—and I feel like I need to be doing something with all of it. Sitting still just feels like I’m wasting the moment.
How long do these periods of unusual energy and feeling like you need to keep doing things usually last?
It’s been going on for about three months now, I think. It really started after my platform got selected for the Glendale showcase, and since then it’s kind of just kept going.

During these past three months, has there been a time when your mood was noticeably more elevated, irritable, or expansive—like you were on top of the world or unusually confident—along with an increase in activity, like starting multiple projects or rushing to get things done?

Yes. Most days I feel kind of lit up, like I’m ahead of everyone else and Glendale finally caught up to what I’ve been building. I feel really confident, like I can push everything forward if people would just get out of the way.

And I have been trying to get a lot done at once. But I also get irritated fast—especially when my wife or coworkers slow me down with what they call “process.” I snap at them harder than I probably should.
